STUDY 131
Purple Velvet Cardigan & Ruffled Mini
Rights check
Source: 25008.jpg
IMAGE PROMPT
An original young woman with long, straight dark hair
walks along a flagstone path beside a lawn with dry
leaves. She wears a purple velvet cropped V-neck
cardigan with gold trim and a small pendant necklace,
plus a dark ruffled mini skirt with gold studs. Knee-high
purple lace socks and lace-up gray sneakers complete
the look. A small backpack hangs from one shoulder.
Her expression is calm and direct. Warm autumn
sunlight. Palette of violet, charcoal, and gold. Preppy
and nostalgic, in the style of a 2000s campus
street-style photo.
Preppy, nostalgic, playful
WORKING NOTES
- The velvet cardigan and ruffled skirt are the signature
pieces.
- Keep the flagstone path for a sense of movement.
